description: This file defines an extension to the OnboardingView SwiftUI view, providing its layout and UI components for an onboarding flow in a macOS application. It includes view composition, navigation controls, and interaction handling.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main layout and UI of the OnboardingView, including components like icons, page views, navigation bar, and lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: activePageIndex
methods.description: Calculates the current page index based on a cursor, with bounds checking.

methods.name: reconcilePageForModeChange
methods.description: Adjusts the current page in response to mode changes, ensuring the correct page is displayed with animation.

methods.name: onboardingPage
methods.description: Provides a scrollable container for onboarding content with custom styling.

methods.name: onboardingCard
methods.description: Creates a styled card view with padding, background, and shadow for onboarding content.

methods.name: onboardingGlassCard
methods.description: Creates a semi-transparent, glass-like styled card with rounded shape and border.

methods.name: featureRow
methods.description: Builds a feature display row with title, subtitle, and icon.

methods.name: featureActionRow
methods.description: Builds a feature row that includes an actionable button.

methods.name: featureRowContent
methods.description: Helper method to assemble content for feature rows with optional action buttons.
